Having attained your darshan (vision), my darshan is fulfilled. Great yogis repeatedly take birth
and keep aspiring to have a vision of your divine form in deep meditation.

Meaning: Here, Shri Bhagwan is called the abode of all virtues and all bliss.
Is. Real happiness is not found until the quality of goodness is attained.

you are the abode of all things, and now you have attained the perfection of seeing by looking at your own eyes."
You have attained it." Such statements are purely devotional. For a devotee, the significance of the senses is in serving God. free from all kinds of worldly attachments and fully
